```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/satellite_courses.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
overview = data.get("overview", {})
resources = data.get("resources", {})
faq = data.get("faq", {})

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def render_markdown(value):
    text = str(value or "").replace(
        "(contact_us.qmd)", "(contact_us.html)"
    )
    return markdown.markdown(
        text,
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# RESOURCE LINKS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

resource_links = ""

for resource in resources.get("links", []):
    resource_links += f"""
    <a class="cw-course-resource"
       href="{safe(resource.get('url'))}"
       target="_blank"
       rel="noopener noreferrer">
      <span>{safe(resource.get('title'))}</span>
      <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
    </a>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# FAQ ITEMS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

faq_items = ""

for item in faq.get("questions", []):
    faq_items += f"""
    <details class="cw-course-faq-item">
      <summary>
        <span>{safe(item.get('question'))}</span>
        <span class="cw-course-faq-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      </summary>

      <div class="cw-course-faq-answer">
        {render_markdown(item.get('answer'))}
      </div>
    </details>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-courses">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="cw-courses-hero">
    <div class="cw-courses-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-courses-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get('description'))}</p>

      <a href="{safe(hero.get('button_url'))}"
         class="cw-courses-hero-btn"
         target="_blank"
         rel="noopener noreferrer">
        {safe(hero.get('button_label'))}
        <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
      </a>

    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- OVERVIEW -->
  <section class="cw-courses-overview">

    <span class="cw-courses-section-label">
      {safe(overview.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h2>{safe(overview.get('title'))}</h2>

    <div class="cw-courses-overview-text">
      {render_markdown(overview.get('description'))}
    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- RESOURCES -->
  <section class="cw-courses-resources">

    <span class="cw-courses-section-label">
      {safe(resources.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h2>{safe(resources.get('title'))}</h2>

    <div class="cw-courses-resource-list">
      {resource_links}
    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- FAQ -->
  <section class="cw-courses-faq">

    <div class="cw-courses-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-courses-section-label">
        {safe(faq.get('eyebrow'))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(faq.get('title'))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-courses-faq-list">
      {faq_items}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
